description: Lists the files and folders in a folder, with sizes and dates. Only the allowed folders (such as core_dump, the C sample project, and tools) and their sub-folders can be listed; omit the path to see the allowed folder names.

params.name: path
params.description: <allowed folder name>/<sub-folder>, e.g. core_dump or core_dump/src/modules; omit it to list the allowed folder names
